churches.name: Covenant Fellowship Church

score_notes.christology: PCA denomination + Westminster Standards — explicit Trinitarian orthodoxy. Site header confirms 'Welcome to Covenant Fellowship Church (PCA)!'
score_notes.scripture: Westminster Standards affirm Scripture as infallible rule; PCA polity requires inerrancy.
score_notes.gender: PCA male-only ordination (complementarian halfway-house per rubric); Pastor James (male).
score_notes.soteriology: Reformed sola fide soteriology per Westminster Confession.
score_notes.cultural: Korean-heritage Presbyterian tradition tends conservative; no DEI/CRT on homepage.
score_notes.preaching: 'Gospel-centered Biblical truth' core value (G.L.A.D. values); specific expository style not confirmed.
score_notes.mission: G.L.A.D. values include 'Disciple-making disciples' — explicit mission focus.
score_notes.denominational: PCA confirmed on homepage ('Covenant Fellowship Church (PCA)') — Westminster Confession + Book of Church Order accountability.

churches.assessment: Covenant Fellowship Church in West Orange was formerly the English Ministry of Antioch Presbyterian Church, with Pastor James as lead pastor. Korean heritage Presbyterian tradition tends conservative; verify complementarian convictions.
churches.denomination_detail: PCA (Presbyterian Church in America) — Korean heritage congregation (formerly English Ministry of Antioch Presbyterian Church)

churches.name: Messiah's Reformed Fellowship NYC

score_notes.christology: URCNA confessional standards (Three Forms of Unity) imply orthodox Trinitarian Christology; parish-level explicit statement not on homepage — green by denominational standard.
score_notes.scripture: Bible-believing evangelical posture; inerrancy typically affirmed.
score_notes.gender: Male pastoral leadership observed; complementarian baseline (CBMW halfway position; MOOP holds patriarchal headship as the biblical standard).
score_notes.leadership: Male pastor(s) confirmed via church website.
score_notes.soteriology: Historic evangelical gospel of grace through faith alone.
score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT vocabulary on site; covenantal Reformed framing.
score_notes.preaching: URCNA tradition is typically expository with catechetical preaching; site confirms catechism service at 10:30 AM preceding worship.
score_notes.mission: Mission described as 'covenantal community shaped by the gospel that displays the glory of God in all areas of life from generation to generation' and 'biblical faithful church, full of love, doctrinal truth, community, and discipleship.'
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Not stated on available sources — verify in person. Site mentions Thursday Bible studies and Tuesday prayer meetings but no dedicated men's ministry visible.
score_notes.denominational: Homepage confirms 'confessionally Reformed church' and membership in URCNA (United Reformed Churches in North America) — denominational accountability verified via homepage.

churches.assessment: Messiah's Reformed Fellowship is a Reformed congregation in Manhattan with a Messianic Jewish emphasis. Confessional Reformed framework with Scripture inerrancy and male-only eldership expected.

churches.name: Middle Collegiate Church
churches.address: 50 E 7th St (temporary after 2020 fire), New York, NY 10003
churches.denomination: Reformed Church in America / Collegiate Churches of NY

score_notes.scripture: Jacqui Lewis preaches universalist-leaning theology, denies substitutionary atonement categories, and reads Scripture through a justice-as-gospel frame.
score_notes.cultural: "Multiracial, multicultural, welcoming, artistic, activist" is the self-description; flagship progressive congregation in NYC.
score_notes.denominational: Collegiate Churches of NY (RCA-affiliated but the most progressive branch).

churches.assessment: Middle Collegiate Church under Jacqui Lewis is one of the most visible progressive pulpits in New York, preaching a universalist-tinged "love-is-love" gospel that treats justice activism as the content of the Christian message. Female senior minister, fully LGBTQ-affirming, and openly non-exclusivist on Christ — this is progressivism at its most developed.
